account_id.description: The expense or asset account the line costs.

gst.description: The line's GST as the supplier states it, in the bill's currency; 0 when none is charged.

gst_code.description: The line's GST code for purchases, from the sg-gst pack: TX, IM, ZP, BL, NR, EP or OP.

net.description: The line's amount before GST, in the bill's currency.

stated_gst.description: For a bill in another currency: the GST the tax invoice states in the base currency, which is the input tax claimed (ENG-42). Without it the input tax is not claimed and stays in the cost (⚠).
